newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-SIGEL WINS SENIOR TOUR CHAMPIONSHIP BY TWO STROKES.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SIGEL WINS SENIOR TOUR CHAMPIONSHIP BY TWO STROKES.

text.p: Jay Sigel pocketed the senior season's biggest check when he posted an even-par 72 Sunday to win the Senior Tour Championship by two strokes at The Dunes Golf & Beach Club.
Sigel, who held a three-shot lead entering the final round, finished at nine-under-par 279 to claim the $280,000 first prize. Kermit Zarley shot 69 for second place at 281.
The victory for Sigel, a two-time U.S. Amateur champion and member of nine U.S. Walker Cup squads, was his first of the season and second of his senior tour career.
Defending champion Jim Colbert shot 69 to finish tied for third at 283 with South African John Bland and move past Hale Irwin for the 1996 money title.
Colbert, who won five events this year, boosted his season's earnings to $1,627,890, some $12,000 more than Irwin, who finished tied for 10th after a final-round 70.
Jim Dent was alone in fifth place at four-under 284 after a 71.
